_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Speak with Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
Toss three Forsaken Stink Bombs into the heart of Southshore in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemi…
Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

quests.n: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
quests.t: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites. Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it. Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

o.t: Destroy the command tent and plant the Scourge banner in the camp

quests.t: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western P…
Find Pamela Redpath.
Find Pamela's doll.
Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.
Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 5 Skin of Shadow.
Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

o.t: Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits
Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits
Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits

quests.t: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the po…
Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used…
Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons…
Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the po…
Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Find Carlin Redpath.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have complete…
Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov. Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.
Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sar…
Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the h…
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square. Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus. Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears. Defeat Redpath the Corrupted. Speak with the spirit of J…
Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

o.t: Search the false grave for the Taelan's Hammer.

quests.t: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to…
Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring. Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

quests.n: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
quests.t: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.
Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

o.t: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

quests.t: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers. You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

quests.n: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
quests.t: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked. Once you plan…
Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.t: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.
Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command. Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.
Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

quests.n: The Balance of Light and Shadow

o.t: The Balance of Light and Shadow

quests.t: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task. You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.
Place the Rotten Eggs in the main brew keg located inside the Southshore Inn.
Do a chicken emote at Innkeeper Norman, and in exchange you'll receive an Undercity Mint!
Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.
Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.
Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity's Apothecarium.
Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the Undercity.
Speak with Innkeeper Norman in the Undercity.
Speak with Mara Rennick at the tailor's shop in the Undercity's Mage Quarter.
Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the Hillsbrad Foothills past Ravenholdt Manor.

o.n: Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

quests.t: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands wi…
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.
Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 2 Arcane Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.
Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.
Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.
Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.

Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver the signed Writ of Safe Passage to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Deliver 3 Huge Thorium Battleaxes and the Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 3 Radiant Circlets and the Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 10 Wicked Leather Headbands and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 25 Rugged Armor Kits and the Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 4 Runic Leather Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Runic Leather Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 6 Brightcloth Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 8 Runecloth Boots and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 8 Runecloth Bags and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Bag - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 8 Runecloth Robes and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Robe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 20 Goblin Sapper Charges and the Craftsman's Writ - Goblin Sapper Charge - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 20 Thorium Grenades and the Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Grenade - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 4 Gnomish Battle Chickens and the Craftsman's Writ - Gnomish Battle Chicken - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 14 Thorium Tubes and the Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Tube - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 10 Major Mana Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Mana Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

s.n: Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion

quests.t: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 20 Major Healing Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 1 Flask of Petrification and the Craftsman's Writ - Flask of Petrification - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 40 Stonescale Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 30 Plated Armorfish and the Craftsman's Writ - Plated Armorfish - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Deliver 30 Lightning Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.
Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.

quests.t: For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

s.n: A Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls

quests.t: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
